# EdrawMax by Wondershare

> > EdrawMax is a comprehensive diagramming and visualization platform offering AI-powered tools for creating floor plans, technical diagrams, charts, and professional visualizations across architecture, software development, and business analysis.

EdrawMax Online and desktop versions provide templates, AI generators, and tutorials for creating everything from AWS architecture diagrams and data flow diagrams to kitchen planners and statistical charts. The platform supports both 2D and 3D design workflows with extensive symbol libraries and collaborative features.

## Key Topics

- EdrawMax diagramming software
- Wondershare visualization tools
- Data flow diagrams (DFD)
- Floor plan design (2D and 3D)
- AI symbol generator
- Chart creation and data visualization
- AWS architecture diagrams
- C++ and programming data structures
- Venn and Euler diagrams
- Kitchen and room planners
- Blueprint and building design
- LIFO and FIFO structures
- EdrawMax Online tutorials
- Interior design tools
- Software development diagramming
